summary: GSK plc filed a routine Form 6-K disclosing PDMR share dealings by three senior officers: Group General Counsel James Ford, US President Maya Martinez-Davis, and Chief Digital and Technology Officer Shobie Ramakrishnan. Each acquired American Depositary Shares on the New York Stock Exchange on 2026-10-13 at $46.9482 per ADS through automatic reinvestment of dividends paid 8 October 2026 — volumes of 326.441, 351.842, and 724.875 ADS respectively. These are single, non-aggregated transactions. No board recommendation, advisor, deal terms, or structural mechanics appear; this is an ordinary insiders' dealing notification with no special-situation or arbitrage angle.
